evidence.quote: This is the first in a series of status reports on the 1100 open problems listed in the book "Open Problems in Topology" (1990; see the preceding review), edited by the authors.
Our goal is to give a brief account of problems solved, by whom, and whether preprints are available.
In addition to announcements of new solutions, these reports will contain a matrix of problem numbers updated to indicate those problems still open.

trace.notes: Resolved zbMATH 4184372 to the exact work titled 'Open problems in topology' with DOI 10.1016/0166-8641(91)90043-L and publisher landing page https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/016686419190043L. Crossref and Elsevier metadata confirmed the identity of the same work. The accessible ScienceDirect page exposed bibliographic metadata and open-archive markers but no visible article body or problem statements in the fetched content.

No candidate open problems were extracted because the resolved accessible source for this exact work did not expose self-contained problem statements; the zbMATH page described the item only as a status report and matrix update for problems in the 1990 book.

Failed source adequacy gate. Accepting any problem from resolver summaries or metadata would violate the requirement not to extract from bibliographic metadata when the technical problem statements are not visible in the chosen source text.
Saved JSON to outputs/parse-paper/open-problems-in-topology-1991.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
